title: Clem's Secret

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: Thanks for covering for me, camarero. I owe you. Big time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks for covering for me, camarero. I owe you. Big time.

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: Sure. Is it about those new turbocorn seeds? Because I don’t know--

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. Is it about those new turbocorn seeds? Because I don’t know--

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: Haha. What. No. Illegal? LOL. Hahaha. Who would do that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Haha. What. No. Illegal? LOL. Hahaha. Who would do that?

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: Shit. Alright, you've done me a favor and you knew Thaddeus so... I'm part of something. A movement. Project Grapevine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Shit. Alright, you've done me a favor and you knew Thaddeus so... I'm part of something. A movement. Project Grapevine.

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: Wherever there's an inch of dirt, we sow a flower.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wherever there's an inch of dirt, we sow a flower.

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: No such thing as a free lunch, huh? Listen, I don't have much... but I can spare a meat printing module. If you're serious about growing, that's your next step.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No such thing as a free lunch, huh? Listen, I don't have much... but I can spare a meat printing module. If you're serious about growing, that's your next step.

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: See? Business doesn't have to be cut-throat. We're all in this together, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: See? Business doesn't have to be cut-throat. We're all in this together, right?

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: If that's what you think, then I'm sure you will climb high. Just don't forget who held the ladder for you, greenfingers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If that's what you think, then I'm sure you will climb high. Just don't forget who held the ladder for you, greenfingers.

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: It's something Thaddeus told me once: when you start to climb, never forget who's holding the ladder.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's something Thaddeus told me once: when you start to climb, never forget who's holding the ladder.

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: It's a Category C offense at least. The penalties range from a 10,000 Lim fine and permit confiscation to exile in the Wastes. They almost caught me last time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a Category C offense at least. The penalties range from a 10,000 Lim fine and permit confiscation to exile in the Wastes. They almost caught me last time.

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: I know, but I can't. We are at a crucial stage of the plan: drop a fast-acting seed bomb on the Oil Rig.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know, but I can't. We are at a crucial stage of the plan: drop a fast-acting seed bomb on the Oil Rig.

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: Flowers! Dozens of flowers! It will be glorious. IF I don't get arrested first. They have me on a watch list, I think.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Flowers! Dozens of flowers! It will be glorious. IF I don't get arrested first. They have me on a watch list, I think.

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: Aim of the game, Greenfingers. Wish me luck.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aim of the game, Greenfingers. Wish me luck.

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: Are you serious? Because you know the penalty...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you serious? Because you know the penalty...

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: OK. All you gotta do is take this package to the Oil Rig, drop it and get outta there without being caught. Right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: OK. All you gotta do is take this package to the Oil Rig, drop it and get outta there without being caught. Right?

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: I'm trusting you, Greenfingers. Don't make me regret it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm trusting you, Greenfingers. Don't make me regret it.

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: Have you ever seen a daisy split concrete in two? Flowers are tough. They have networks, roots. Every time people see our gardens, they remember that CorpSec can't control everything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you ever seen a daisy split concrete in two? Flowers are tough. They have networks, roots. Every time people see our gardens, they remember that CorpSec can't control everything.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: HOW big time?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: HOW big time?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can I ask you something?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can I ask you something?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you involved in... secret illegal gardening?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you involved in... secret illegal gardening?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you involved in... secret illegal gardening?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you involved in... secret illegal gardening?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So those news reports about vigilante gardening have nothing to do with you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So those news reports about vigilante gardening have nothing to do with you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So those news reports about vigilante gardening have nothing to do with you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So those news reports about vigilante gardening have nothing to do with you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Meaning?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Meaning?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You've got a deal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You've got a deal.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right. I agree.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right. I agree.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wrong. Everyone is on their own.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wrong. Everyone is on their own.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Wrong. Everyone is on their own.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Wrong. Everyone is on their own.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks, Clem.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks, Clem.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sounds illegal...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds illegal...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Badass!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Badass!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like you should lay low for a while.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like you should lay low for a while.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds like you should lay low for a while.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds like you should lay low for a while.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What will happen?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What will happen?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, don't get caught.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, don't get caught.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll do it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll do it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: CorpSec don't scare me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: CorpSec don't scare me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, I heard through the grapevine ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I heard through the grapevine ...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Well, I heard through the grapevine ...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Well, I heard through the grapevine ...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ha! I knew it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha! I knew it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The cause is worth it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The cause is worth it.
